title: Reflection classes of the exceptional-divisor period are proportional to the Iritani images of the exceptional line-bundle differences
author: Milanov, Todor; Xia, Xiaokun
work: Reflection Vectors and Quantum Cohomology of Blowups (SIGMA 20 (2024), article 029)
difficulty_reason: The statement identifies the classes in the exceptional-divisor state space whose periods are exchanged by the monodromy reflection gamma_k as exactly the Iritani images of the exceptional line-bundle differences (statement lines 3229-3241). The proof transports the reflection condition through the period comparison of the preceding proposition, converts the projective reflection vector explicitly to the blowup coordinates with Gamma-function reflection identities and the q-to-Q conversion, and verifies proportionality against the Iritani image computed through the Gamma-class factorization and the Chern character of the exceptional object (proof lines 3243-3282). The counted span cites one theorem of the same chapter and no external work; it is carried as a navigation stub.
